# WARNING: every secret in this file is a well-known example value, chosen to be
# readable rather than secure. This deployment is a local demonstration of
# FerretDB compatibility. Do not expose it to a network you do not control.

DJANGO_DEBUG=False
TEMPLATE_DEBUG=False
USE_X_FORWARDED_HOST=False

CELERY_BROKER_URL=redis://:squirrel@redis-main.kobo.private:6379/1
CELERY_AUTOSCALE_MIN=2
CELERY_AUTOSCALE_MAX=6

DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=insecure-demo-secret-key-not-for-production-use
DJANGO_SESSION_COOKIE_AGE=604800
DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=.kobo.local .docker.internal

# Required. uWSGI mounts the application at this path; if the variable is unset,
# `uwsgi.ini` mounts on the literal string `$(KPI_PREFIX)` and every request
# returns HTTP 500 with "no python application found".
KPI_PREFIX=/

SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN=".kobo.local"

# Comma separated domains
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_WHITELISTED_HOSTS=kf.docker.internal

# See "api key" here: https://github.com/kobotoolbox/enketo-express/tree/master/config#linked-form-and-data-server.
# Must match the "api key" in `env/enketo_express/config.json`.
ENKETO_API_KEY=enketorabbit

# The initial superuser's username.
KOBO_SUPERUSER_USERNAME=super
# The initial superuser's password.
KOBO_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD=admin
# The e-mail address where your users can contact you.
CONSTANCE_SUPPORT_EMAIL=support@kobo.local

KOBOFORM_URL=http://kf.kobo.local
KOBOFORM_INTERNAL_URL=http://kf.docker.internal # Always use HTTP internally.
ENKETO_URL=http://ee.kobo.local
ENKETO_INTERNAL_URL=http://ee.docker.internal # Always use HTTP internally.
KOBOCAT_URL=http://kc.kobo.local
KOBOCAT_INTERNAL_URL=http://kc.docker.internal # Always use HTTP internally.
